claim_boundary: Calibration-source acquisition, synchronization, tactile alignment, robot-state recovery, and action-only window-selection evidence. It is not a provider-competence result, a BayesianPhysTwin accuracy result, a tactile-benefit result, a calibrated-uncertainty result, a confirmation result, or a state-of-the-art claim.
information_order: verify the committed Stage-0 selection and data-free visual-provider lock
list exact official-Hub calibration object paths at the registered dataset revision without opening file bytes
seal one exact selected-episode file plan per calibration object
stop without payload access if the names-only support gate fails
download and hash only the planned calibration files
prepare synchronized RGB, tactile, and robot state for the ten calibration units without replacement
select one 81-frame window from robot actions and openings only
stop without confirmation access if the calibration-source support gate fails
use the sealed windows in a later calibration-only MotionCrafter, Prob4D, contact, physical-response, guard, and interval selection
seal all eight calibration artifacts and the complete evidence-use ledger before any confirmation payload access

processing.audio_policy: FLAC and WAV files are not admitted
processing.camera_policy: all streams with an exact selected-episode MP4/timestamp pair; the official processing code keeps only streams covered by released refined calibration
processing.selected_episode_staging: The original selected episode is materialized as the sole synthetic raw episode 0 without changing source bytes; the original object and episode identities remain in every manifest.
processing.tactile_policy: all named sensors with an exact selected-episode raw NPY/timestamp pair and one released median baseline
